ApiErrorDetails.description:
The ``details`` object carried by every non-2xx response.

See ``backend.md §6.0``. ``errorCode`` + ``category`` are both mandatory
(``backend.md §6.3.2``): the only exception is the "§6.5 wholly-unknown
unhandled exception" safety-net which emits ``details: null`` and is
documented separately.

category.description: Coarse failure category. The frontend's fallback dispatcher (backend.md §6.3.2 step 2) keys off this field when the exact ``errorCode`` is not yet recognized.

errorCode.description: Stable SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE identifier for the failure. Business prefixes (ANALYSIS_* / CONVERSATION_* / SEMANTIC_*) are owned by this service; infrastructure prefixes (GATEWAY_* / INTERNAL_*) are injected by the gateway or the service-to-service auth filter and are reported for traceability.
errorCode.title: Errorcode

ApiErrorDetails.title: ApiErrorDetails

ApiErrorResponse.description:
The full non-2xx envelope (``backend.md §6.0``).

Top-level ``code`` equals the HTTP status; ``data`` is always absent on
failure; ``details`` is always present except for the §6.5 safety-net.

code.description: HTTP status code; strictly equal to the transport status line. Must NOT carry a 5-digit legacy business code (sunset, backend.md §6.3).
code.title: Code

details.description: Structured failure details. Present on every non-2xx response except the §6.5 wholly-unknown-exception safety-net.

message.description: Human-readable short description (do not leak internals).
message.title: Message

requestId.description: Request trace id; echoed from gateway-injected ``X-Request-Id`` or a ``missing-<8 hex>`` fallback when the header is absent (backend.md §5).
requestId.title: Requestid

ApiErrorResponse.title: ApiErrorResponse

ErrorCategory.description:
Coarse failure categories used by ``details.category`` (``backend.md §6.0``).

The frontend's fallback UX hook keys off these values when the precise
``errorCode`` is unrecognized — see ``backend.md §6.3.2``.
ErrorCategory.title: ErrorCategory

SSEEventName.description: Server-sent event names emitted by POST /api/v1/analysis. Mirrors app.schemas.events.SSEEventType.
SSEEventName.title: SSEEventName

post.description: Submit an analysis question. Returns SSE stream of events.

get.description: Get a completed analysis result by session ID.
